clips.title: The story
paras: Creeper Ichor is a rare, virulent fluid harvested from the moss creepers lurking throughout the forests of the Hillsbrad Foothills. It is sought by the Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill as a potent biological agent for formulating novel plagues against the living.

In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon conducts experiments to craft deadly new toxins, seeking to eradicate the surrounding human population. Despising the clean air and vibrant life of the foothills, Lydon searches for natural toxins and biological catalysts native to the local wildlife. The venomous fluids of the forest's giant arachnids, particularly the elusive ichor found within mature moss creepers, serve as an ideal base for his Elixir of Suffering. Mixed with other reagents like gray bear tongues, this fluid aids the Forsaken in perfecting their craft of lethal alchemy.
